acceptanceCriteria: The cleanup-confirmation contract change, if any, is recorded as an owner-accepted AHI-050 amendment.
A deterministic test reproduces the slow-reap timing and passes with the fix.
A hosted macos-15 run passes host-adapter-test and TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHosts, with the run id retained.
body: Observed in release-gates nightly run 38052349384 (2026-10-10, macos-15): host-adapter-test and cmd/corvint TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHosts returned corvint-process-cleanup-unconfirmed where timeout was expected, in a different OpenCode subtest each time. Not reproduced locally (2/2 passes at load ~94, RC3 lane F, PR beamfall/corvint#739). The failure first appears after the V1-0371 commits 7a4078b8, fd48aee7 and c05bf0a4, which narrowed cleanup confirmation to an ESRCH-only probe; the earlier check also accepted EPERM after the leader exited. Inference, unconfirmed: the hosted VM reaps zombies slowly, or the 100 ms reap timer fires before close. A fix (bounded re-probe, or EPERM-after-reap acceptance) changes the AHI-050 contract and needs an owner decision. Related to V1-0849 / V1-0762 but a new regression, not load flake. Blocks a green nightly for 1.0.0-rc.3 (decision 0491).
title: OpenCode host adapter reports corvint-process-cleanup-unconfirmed on hosted macos-15 since V1-0371
